newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia finance ministry says it paid Sberbank late.
newsitem.headline: Russia finance ministry says it paid Sberbank late.

text.p: Russia's finance ministry was late in making payments on Monday to the state savings bank, Sberbank, a senior ministry official said on Thursday.
Bella Zlatkis, head of the securities department, told Reuters the finance ministry had mistakenly delayed the transfer of 482 billion roubles to Sberbank, Russia's biggest bank.
"We state openly that this was an error by our treasury, and not a problem at Sberbank. There are no problems at Sberbank," she said.
The money was due to be transferred by Sberbank to other commercial banks in the overnight credit market on Monday, she told Reuters.
The money was all paid by Monday evening, she added.
